MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.DownloadPythonV: Python installation is now handled by UV. Use VirtualEnvironment with a Python version string, such as "3.10", instead.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.InstallPackages: Replace this component with InstallPackages(PythonEnvironment, List<String>, Boolean). Supply an environment created using the UV workflow and set run to true.

MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.InstallRequirem: Requirements-file installation has been removed. Declare dependencies in pyproject.toml and create the environment from that file, or supply package requirements to InstallPackages with run set to true.

Requirements-file installation using an executable path has been removed. Declare dependencies in pyproject.toml and create the environment from that file, or use InstallPackages with a PythonEnvironment and run set to true.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.InstallPackageL: Replace this component with InstallPackageLocal(PythonEnvironment, String, Boolean). Supply an environment created using the UV workflow and set run to true.

MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RemoveKernel(Sy: Use RemoveJupyterKernel with the name of a UV-managed BHoM environment and set run to true. Legacy kernels may require manual removal using Jupyter.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RemoveAllKernel: Bulk kernel removal has been removed. Use RemoveJupyterKernel for individual UV-managed BHoM environments with run set to true. Legacy kernels may require manual removal using Jupyter.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RemoveVirtualEn: Replace this component with RemoveVirtualEnvironment(String, Boolean) and set run to true. It removes environments in the new BHoM Python directory; legacy environments require separate cleanup.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RemoveAllVirtua: Bulk environment removal has been removed. Use RemoveVirtualEnvironment for each named environment and set run to true. RemoveEverything also removes BHoM-managed UV tools, so use it only when that broader cleanup is intended.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RemoveBaseVersi: The former base Python installation workflow has been removed. Use RemoveVirtualEnvironment for named BHoM environments. Removing UV does not uninstall UV-managed Python runtimes or legacy Python installations.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RemoveEverythin: Replace this component with RemoveEverything(Boolean) and set run to true. Review its scope: it targets the new BHoM Python environments and managed UV tools, not legacy installations.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RequirementsTxt: Requirements-file generation has been removed. Manage project dependencies using pyproject.toml and UV. Use UV export separately if a requirements.txt file is needed.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.UnzipFile(Syste: This archive-extraction helper has been removed. Use a separate archive-extraction workflow if needed.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.UpdateBHoMPacka: Use UpdateBHoMPackages(PythonEnvironment) with an environment created using the UV workflow. The PythonVersion enum input is no longer supported.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.VirtualEnvironm: Replace this component with VirtualEnvironment(String, String, Boolean). Replace the PythonVersion enum with a version string, such as "3.10", and recreate the environment using UV.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Query.DirectoryKernels(: The fixed kernel-directory query has been removed. Use Jupyter kernelspec discovery to locate registered kernels.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Query.DirectoryCode(): The separate PythonCode directory is no longer used. Toolkit project files now reside under DirectoryEnvironments(), within the toolkit's named directory.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Query.DirectoryBaseEnvi: Base Python environments are no longer organised by PythonVersion. Use a named UV-managed environment and query its directory or executable instead.
Python downloads are now managed by UV. Use VirtualEnvironment with a Python version string instead of retrieving an installer URL.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Query.IsValidEnvironmen: This legacy environment-name validation method has been removed. Review names against the requirements of the UV environment and Jupyter kernel workflows.
MessageForDeleted.BH.Engine.Python.Query.VirtualEnvironmen: Replace this component with VirtualEnvironmentExists(String). It checks the new UV-managed BHoM environment layout and no longer accepts a PythonVersion input.

MessageForDeleted.BH.oM.Python.Enums.PythonVersion: Python versions are now specified as strings, such as "3.10" or "3.11". Replace enum inputs with the appropriate version string and recreate environments using the UV workflow.

MessageForNoUpgrade.BH.Engine.Python.Compute.RunCommandStdou: The output has changed from a single string to stdout, stderr and exit code. Review and reconnect downstream components manually. Exit code zero indicates success; -1 indicates timeout.
MessageForNoUpgrade.BH.Engine.Python.Query.Version(System.St: The output is now a Python version string instead of PythonVersion. Replace downstream enum-based comparisons and inputs with string-based equivalents.
